title: Technology Sector Update for 01/03/2018: MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG, BB, BIDU, SIRI, ORCL, ATUS, SPNS
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +0.05%
AAPL: flat
IBM: +1.6%
CSCO: flat
GOOG: +0.2%
Technology shares were mixed in pre-market trading Wednesday.
Expected movers:
- BlackBerry ( BB ): enters connected, autonomous car technology collaboration with Baidu ( BIDU )
- Sirius XM ( SIRI ): downgraded to Market Perform by Barrington amid royalty ruling
- Oracle ( ORCL ): upgraded to Overweight from Equal Weight at Morgan Stanley
Other news:
- Altice USA ( ATUS ): said to have pulled Starz (STRZA) and Encore movie channels from cable lineup
- Sapiens (SPNS): acquires KnowledgePrice for undisclosed sum
